ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
InterfaceIndex
The index of the network interface requested for this DNSquery.
RequestType
An enum that represents the type of request made for this specificDNS query. See
https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/cc982162.aspx [https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-

AAAA (0x001C)
ANY (0x00FF)
DomainName
The actual domain name being queried in this request.
DualRequest
Set to 1 if the DNS request was a 'dual-mode' request. This means both a IPv6 and IPv4 request were made, though the event will only
indicate that it is a IPv6 request.
DnsRequestCount
A per-process count of service events generated. On windows and linux, has been deprecated, and the value will always be 1.

Values:

Field
Description
RespondingDnsServer IP address of the responding DNS server to a DNS query.
QueryStatus
This is a UM error code for query status. Listed below are definitions of the following values.
DNS_ERROR_RECORD_DOES_NOT_EXIST (9701) - DNS record does not exist.
DNS_ERROR_RCODE_NAME_ERROR (9003) - DNS name does not exist.
CS_ERROR_SINGLE_RESPONSE_EXPECTING_DUAL (0xff000001) - Internal error. Got a response to a single query while waiting
for a second dual-query element for the same domain.
CS_ERROR_DUAL_RECORDS (0xff000002) - Internal error. Got a second set of responses to a dual query while waiting on a
failed request for the same domain.
Values:
DNS_ERROR_RECORD_DOES_NOT_EXIST (9701)
DNS_ERROR_RCODE_NAME_ERROR (9003)
CS_ERROR_SINGLE_RESPONSE_EXPECTING_DUAL (0xff000001)
CS_ERROR_DUAL_RECORDS (0xff000002)
IP4Records
String representing the extracted IPv4 records.
IP6Records
String representing the extracted IPv6 records.
CNAMERecords
String representing the extracted CNAME records.
FirstIP4Record
First IPv4 record in the DnsQuery.
FirstIP6Record
First IPv6 record in the DnsQuery.
ContextBaseFileName The base ImageFileName of the context process.
